# GENERATED by tools/li_soul_regimes/build_soul_regimes.py (2026-11-26): LI soul governments as regimes. Edit the generator.

# Character: take a regime. $REGIME$ = demagogic / anarchist / mystic / absolutist / hegemonic / messianic
LR_soul_regime_set_effect = {
	LR_soul_regime_clear_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = LR_soul_regime value = flag:$REGIME$ }
	add_character_modifier = LR_soul_regime_$REGIME$_modifier
}

# Character: drop whatever regime is held (silently)
LR_soul_regime_clear_effect = {
	remove_variable = LR_soul_regime
	if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = LR_soul_regime_demagogic_modifier } remove_character_modifier = LR_soul_regime_demagogic_modifier }
	if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = LR_soul_regime_anarchist_modifier } remove_character_modifier = LR_soul_regime_anarchist_modifier }
	if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = LR_soul_regime_mystic_modifier } remove_character_modifier = LR_soul_regime_mystic_modifier }
	if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = LR_soul_regime_absolutist_modifier } remove_character_modifier = LR_soul_regime_absolutist_modifier }
	if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = LR_soul_regime_hegemonic_modifier } remove_character_modifier = LR_soul_regime_hegemonic_modifier }
	if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = LR_soul_regime_messianic_modifier } remove_character_modifier = LR_soul_regime_messianic_modifier }
}

# Character (yearly): end a regime whose law or soul is gone; fall into Anarchy at Popular Liberty with little prestige
LR_soul_regime_yearly_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { LR_has_soul_regime_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { LR_has_soul_regime_demagogic_trigger = yes LR_soul_regime_demagogic_law_trigger = no }
					AND = { LR_has_soul_regime_anarchist_trigger = yes LR_soul_regime_anarchist_law_trigger = no }
					AND = { LR_has_soul_regime_mystic_trigger = yes LR_soul_regime_mystic_law_trigger = no }
					AND = { LR_has_soul_regime_absolutist_trigger = yes LR_soul_regime_absolutist_law_trigger = no }
					AND = { LR_has_soul_regime_hegemonic_trigger = yes LR_soul_regime_hegemonic_law_trigger = no }
					AND = { LR_has_soul_regime_messianic_trigger = yes LR_soul_regime_messianic_law_trigger = no }
				}
			}
			LR_soul_regime_clear_effect = yes
			send_interface_toast = {
				title = LR_soul_regime_ended_toast
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				left_icon = root
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			LR_soul_regime_anarchist_law_trigger = yes
			prestige_level <= 1
		}
		send_interface_toast = {
			title = LR_soul_regime_anarchy_toast
			type = event_toast_effect_bad
			left_icon = root
			LR_soul_regime_set_effect = { REGIME = anarchist }
		}
	}
}
